overlay.panelHint: The status window floats above the game and shows whether the servers are fine — green when all systems are operational, amber with a countdown when maintenance is announced. Toggle it with the hotkey.
overlay.waylandHint: Global hotkeys cannot be registered on this desktop session. Bind this command to a key in your desktop settings instead:
overlay.pairHint: Pair with a server above — the window reads the service status through it.
overlay.kdeRuleInstalled: KDE window rule installed — overlays stay above the fullscreen game. (Written to ~/.config/kwinrulesrc; only windows titled "StarBuddy — " match.)
overlay.kdeRuleMissing: KDE stacks a focused fullscreen game above "keep above" windows. A window rule fixes that; StarBuddy adds it the first time an overlay opens.
overlay.sizeStrip: Always a strip while docked top or bottom

status.title: Star Citizen services
status.someIssuesBody: RSI reports a change on one or more systems.
status.notPaired: Pair the client with your StarBuddy server to see the service status.
status.unreachable: Server unreachable — showing nothing rather than guessing.

overlay.scanHint: Scan v1: captures the game screen, finds the signature badge next to a pinged contact and reads it with on-device OCR (models ≈ 15 MB, downloaded once); the scan window shows the signature and the raw readout. Screenshots never leave this machine.

scan.title: Scan
scan.idle: Press the scan hotkey on a scan result.
scan.privacy: Processed locally — the capture is kept in memory only.
